text: Me want cave. Me tired of sleep under tree. Cavewife tired of replaced children who disappear in night.
Me find perfect cave. Cave got firehole, squeegee mold pillow, wife corner, and rock shelf to show
our favorite rock. Cave seller say, I do you deal. Only cost one million cave money, we say.
Me only have three cave money and slightly cursed fifth-born daughter who good at math
but also scream at son. Cave seller laugh so hard he stop breathe and die.
Second cave seller sliver out from under bush like lizard. He no blink. He whisper evil new word.
Word mean, you know have cave money now so you promise give cave money every full moon for next.
Five hundred full moon. But me confused. Me ask, why give cave money later for cave now? Cave seller
do real scary long laugh and disappear in smoke cloud. When smoke go, me see new cave with sign
on top. It say, bank. Me go in. They say, we give you one million cave money now but you give back
two million cave money over many moon. Me say, well two only bid bigger than one so seem pretty
good deal. Wait bank say, it called interest. It like thank you gift to us for letting you
suffer. Cave wife look at me with thousand yards there. So me have no choice. Me sign many stone
slab. Then boom. Me have cave. Me happy. Me decorate. Write down cave sweet cave on bark.
Hang up on wall next to disturbed family cave painting from krug jr. Each moon. Me wake up
and see big shadow in cave door. It big rock lender. With arm like deformed mammoth trunk.
He demand cave money. If ever miss one moon payment though, bank say, ha ha. Me take cave back.
Enjoy sleep under tree. Me say, no. Krug try hard. So me hunt. Me gather. And me deliver
food on kangaroo back to lazy cave man. One day big rock lender show up and he say, you done.
Me falter knees. Cry into floor. Kiss floor. Floor dirty. Me like. Me now own cave. Just in time to
grow many wrinkle and die. Me pass cave to old sun. Sun say, mmm. Cave outdated. Me sell this dump.
Get mortgage on tree. Me haunt tree.
